title: Lane proof reports diff coverage of changed lines
body: Outcome: a lane proof shows that every changed source line is executed by a test after the red-to-green step (diff coverage), and the proof line reports changed lines not covered.

Why: red-first proves a test failed before the fix, not that the new or changed lines run under test; untested branches slip through. The operator was told this is the recommended next lane (predecessor handoff 2026-11-18).
Proof: a test with a change that adds an unexecuted branch reports that line as uncovered; a fully covered change reports zero; the proof line in lane output carries the diff-coverage count.
